affectedPublicSurfaces: demo.app-juli.com /decisions/in-progress/<runId> — the run route's framing and header

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: the demo candidate unit on its own port, before the nginx upstream cutover

journeys.name: the-run-owns-the-page
assertions: the run route renders with no demo-feedback strip, no demo-assistance aside and no mode toggle beside it
the LEFT NAV RAIL REMAINS — owner direction; removing it would strand the seller
a back control labelled Hành động returns to the decisions list
the run title and a status chip render, and the chip's text differs for running / completed / declined / worker_lost

migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change and no backend change. Client rendering only.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: repoint the nginx demo upstream to the retained previous release; the surface reverts whole, never half-applied

doNotInfer: Implement the v3 draft: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/0b588630-321b-4db4-9ac1-5d91e7952f9c — NOT the v4 draft with the Mega Sale band and one-line triage cards. Owner decision 2026-09-14.

Do NOT use useSearchParams in a route that must prerender — it fails the build with missing-suspense-with-csr-bailout and jsdom cannot see it (#1907 shipped a green suite with a broken build on this).

Renaming any user-visible string cascades three ways: the component, the e2e spec's assertions, AND tests/unit/test_phase_2_6_demo_exit_gate.py, which greps spec SOURCE TEXT for prose titles. Grep all three before renaming.
apps/demo/src/__tests__/replay-module-graph.test.ts must stay green — ADR-094 decision 1. If it goes red, stop and report; do not adjust it.
Colour comes only from packages/theme tokens. #1912's token-only-theming test fails any rule declaring a literal colour, blur or shadow on a run-surface selector.
Do not manipulate process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_* in tests — CI has real values. Mock the seam.

THE NAV RAIL STAYS. The issue body originally said to remove all chrome including PrimaryNavigation; the owner corrected that on 2026-09-14 — read the amendment comment on the issue. The run fills the region to the RIGHT of the rail.
Vocabulary is Hành động / Đề xuất / Đang thực hiện / Kết quả. Not 'Gợi ý', not 'Đang chạy', not 'Done'.
Never render a raw stop_reason. Every terminal state resolves through dictionary.md, and a failed run must read as failed — #1322 forbids a state dressed as another.
